{{Quote|That didn't sound good.|The droid, referring to the asteroids hitting the warship.|<ref name="DOAD">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
An '''[[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].

==History==
During the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was ordered by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to increase the power to the forward [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] they were on, so that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] could pass through an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] then informed the [[General/Legends|general]] that they had a clear shot on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. Later, the droid was destroyed along with the rest of Grievous's [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist fleet]] when the Republic forces performed an outflanking maneuver using [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. However, Grievous managed to escape in [[Soulless One/Legends|his starfighter]].
